tbesh_html:
1) (Piel) to perform levirate marriage, perform the duty of a brother-in-law
1a) the duty due to a brother who died childless - to marry his widow and have a son for his name

strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root of doubtful meaning; used only as a denominative from H2993 (יָבָם);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: perform the duty of a husband's brother, marry.
